answer: Let every agent enter through one narrow jetty: one identity per device-and-work history per epoch, each locking a bond slashed on proven fraud. Each agent carries a lantern, a public record of tasks, disputes and slashes anyone can check before trusting it. Auditors on the knoll re-perform a random 5% of claimed work; a failed audit burns the bond and revokes every identity sharing that device fingerprint or funding source. A Sybil attacker must therefore pay a fresh bond and build a fresh history for each fake identity, and one failed audit can wipe a whole cluster.
